qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness, production-admission, and A05.2 closure evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.lowering: The exact block reuses the production-qualified signed bit-string read path. The RIP-relative base resolves from the end of the eight-byte BT instruction, and its CF-only result directly selects the short JAE target.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete ten-byte two-instruction block, RIP-relative displacement and base, qword width, RAX index, JAE condition, and both branch targets must all match. An adjacent RIP, changed displacement, or changed condition declines.

verification.focusedGate: The exact RIP-relative memory-BT block passes its tier-one differential and failed-read matrix.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,500 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Signed indices 0, 64, and -1 and both selected-bit states match the interpreter for complete state, unchanged memory, CF, and exact branch destinations across the measured 25 MiB code-to-data span.
verification.faultCoverage: An unmapped resolved source read preserves complete block-entry state.
verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP, changed RIP-relative displacement, and changed branch condition all decline tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Exact-site absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

a05_2Closure.lazyFlagsRepresentation: The append-only context stores operation/count, width, result, source1, and source2 with interpreter-validated materializers for arithmetic, logical, unary, shift, rotate, and double-shift families.
a05_2Closure.requiredMaterializationBoundaries: PUSHF, LAHF, materialized SETcc/Jcc/CMOVcc, helper calls, native publication, and interrupt delivery boundaries are covered by focused and aggregate tests.
a05_2Closure.nativeConditionPaths: CMP, TEST, SUB, ADD, INC, DEC, and eligible flag-neutral intervening operations retain validated NZCV fast paths; unsupported flag domains materialize or decline atomically.
a05_2Closure.productionEvidence: The pinned full workload succeeds with 1,500-test regression evidence, a measured lazy-materialization counter, prior A/B throughput evidence, and no native-emitter site in the terminal capped sample.
a05_2Closure.remainingFallbackClassification: All retained negative-cache sites are explicit interpreterHelper boundaries permitted by Appendix A.10; they are not evidence of an unimplemented A05.2 flag materializer or native condition path.

interpretation: The exact 5,379-hit RIP-relative memory-BT block is absent. The A05.2 action and check are complete; 115,100 compilation declines remain, but every site in the capped terminal sample is explicitly classified as an interpreter helper rather than a native-emitter gap.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped; zero retained native-emitter sites does not prove that no lower-ranked native-emitter miss exists.
Interpreter-helper retirement remains and is not claimed eliminated by A05.2 closure.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
